Checked again: `lolipopshock` is **not hardcoded**; only the text template is. [`formatReviewComment()`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/response.ts#L229-L246) renders `Requested by @${requestedBy}`. The [orchestrator forwards the original human requester](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1512-L1527), and the [review workflow uses it verbatim](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L373-L385).

The actual review run was triggered by `sepo-agent-app[bot]`. So `Requested by` currently means “started the overall orchestration chain,” not “directly launched this review.”

I agree this is misleading and unnecessarily re-pings you. It is also inconsistent with [orchestrated `fix-pr`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-fix-pr.yml#L278-L294), which already attributes the visible mention to the agent while retaining the human requester internally.

To fix that inconsistency, send:

`@sepo-agent /implement avoid re-tagging the original human in orchestrator-launched review synthesis comments; attribute the visible trigger to the agent while preserving the original requester internally`
